coupling: The earlier thumbnail-size check now admits decoded RGB data up to 512 MiB. At that commit, the decoder grows its string as needed, so the wider bound is safe. The later decoder optimization allocates at most 256 MiB but retains the earlier expectedSize for its write bound. At that commit in the original history, expectedSize is capped at 256 MiB, so the allocation is sufficient. Only together can a valid EPS thumbnail have expectedSize above the allocated capacity; the RLE decoder then writes past DataBuf. Repair requires keeping the size validation, allocation, and write bound consistent across these commits; checking the later write against expectedSize alone or widening the earlier limit alone leaves the combined invariant broken.
